rows.text: with `rbx` as it holds on entry (this body never sets it), stores `edx` in dword `+0xEC`, `rcx` in qword `+0`, `rdx` in qword `+0xF0` and 3 in dword `+0x10` of `rbx`, then adds 0x20 to `rsp`, pops `rbx` and returns the entry `rbx`

notes: 00786F42 is a tail fragment: it reads rbx and unwinds a 0x20-byte frame plus a pushed rbx that it never set up, so it only works when jumped into from a body that did (the page says it is identical-code-folded with btBoxShape). The row states the accesses only and does not say which caller frame applies.
